messages:
ellie (marketing): quick sync — need to lock speakers + timing for next week's webinar. main asks: final speaker order, 1‑slide bio for each, and who covers failover/demo fallback.
kevin (growth): I can take host + intro. ETA for bios? today afternoon would be ideal. :thumbsup:
maria (ops): rehearsal slots available Tue 10:00-11:30 and Wed 14:00-16:00 PT. which do we prefer for full run?
ellie (marketing): @maria let's book Wed 14:00 for the full run, Tue for mic/tech check only. @joyce can you confirm?
joyce (presenter): Wed 14:00 works. I'll be out Tue but can do a quick mic check Mon 16:00 PT if that helps.
rahul (product): can I slot in a 7 minute demo after the 20 min panel? propose: Host intro (5) -> Panel + Q (20) -> Demo (7) -> Customer story (8) -> Closing & CTAs (5). total ~45.
kevin (growth): that looks tight but good. suggest we allocate 5 extra mins buffer after demo for questions/fallback.
ellie (marketing): updated proposed run (please paste into calendar invite):
```
14:00 - 14:05 Host intro (kevin)
14:05 - 14:25 Panel: ops + product + research (ellie, rahul, joyce)
14:25 - 14:32 Live demo (rahul) + instantaneous fallback to pre-recorded clip if latency spike
14:32 - 14:40 Customer vignette + Q&A (guest)
14:40 - 14:45 Closing CTA + lead routing notes (kevin)
```
maria (ops): note on fallback: set up demo proxy + pre-recorded clip. ops checklist: 1) pre-record clip uploaded to S3 2) demo-proxy running in staging 3) stream key verified. I'll add to invite as tasks.
joyce (presenter): for panel, I can talk about model selection and rollout. will send 1‑slide bio + talking points by EOD.
kevin (growth): can marketing draft 2 social teaser copy options? one technical, one product-benefit. I'll pick and schedule.
ellie (marketing): yep, I'll post drafts here by 17:00. also need final speaker headshots. @joyce @rahul please upload to the shared drive.
webinar-bot: rehearsal scheduled: Wed 14:00 PT (full run) — calendar invites sent to participants.
rahul (product): last note: let's record the session and enable captions. also set routing: marketing leads -> SDRs (north-america) + enterprise AE follow-up flag.
kevin (growth): noted. ops + SDRs — please confirm lead routing path after the event.
maria (ops): confirmed on routing path. will provide post-webinar handoff doc and tracking tags.
ellie (marketing): perfect. agree on Wed rehearsal and the run above. closing checklist: bios, headshots, pre-record clip, demo-proxy, teaser copy. I'll ping if anything slips. :sparkles:
